label: preparing
what: A coordinated residents' gathering in the great hall at eighteen, with bread refreshments and a private community presentation. The event is disclosed, but presentation details are withheld and early arrival discouraged; it may celebrate my forty years of service, though that remains a guess. Innkeeper arranges escort and timing; neighbour and baker stock bread. Builder relayed collection arrangements and freight assisted bakery grain work, plausibly supporting preparations; secretary knowingly assists scheduling, but may not know the presentation's contents.
